summary: Prompt 11 (Optimistic Incident Submit + EyeLoader) verified end-to-end on Expo web. Login (+918483029039 / 123456) → language screen (eye logo) → home (home-brand-eye visible) → Report Incident tile → camera (shutter tapped) → preview → Submit. Navigation to /incident/success completed in 117 ms (target <3 s). Success screen correctly showed 'Saved!' initial state with EyeLoader inside incident-uploading-icon; within ~30 s it transitioned to incident-sent-icon + incident-id-text ('Complaint ID: #835FEA22'). AI suggestion card (ai-suggestion-card) appeared; ai-accept tapped and page auto-navigated back home per design. No ActivityIndicator references remain in /app/frontend/src or /app/frontend/app (grep verified — 0 matches). No red-screen errors, no missing-import errors. Expected web warnings only: 'useNativeDriver not supported' (web fallback — documented acceptable), expo-notifications web listener no-op, expo-location Geocoding SDK 49 removal notice, and a minor RN Web deprecation 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'.

react_native_issues.issue: RN Web console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Migrate any <View pointerEvents=...> (e.g., viewerClose SafeAreaView in app/incident/capture.tsx:611) to style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' }}. Cosmetic, non-blocking.

SDK 49 removed the Geocoding API — console warns 'The Geocoding API has been removed in SDK 49, use Place Autocomplete service instead'. If reverseGeocode is still using Location.reverseGeocodeAsync, it will silently no-op on newer SDKs. Reference: /app/frontend/src/utils/geocode.ts (address_text fell back to null in the run — payload still submitted OK).

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Replace pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents on the viewerClose SafeAreaView in app/incident/capture.tsx (~line 611) to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
(Follow-up, not prompt 11 scope) Audit /app/frontend/src/utils/geocode.ts against expo-location SDK ≥49 — Geocoding API removed; provider replacement needed for address_text.
critical_code_review_comments: outbox.ts: 'results' map is in-memory only (documented acceptable). If the user backgrounds+kills the app between enqueue and upload completion, the success screen (opened via oid) will still see the outbox row until upload finishes — fine; on cold-start the row rehydrates from storage and processes on connectivity — good.
incident/success.tsx effectiveRid: chained through outbox results — correctly binds so the AI polling starts as soon as the background upload returns the incident id. Good pattern.
EyeLoader uses useNativeDriver: true — on web this falls back to JS driver (documented). Animation still runs smoothly in the browser during our test.
seed_data_creation: One real incident was created against the live backend as part of the optimistic-submit test — Complaint ID #835FEA22 (CGM Amey Ghadge, dept 'other'/AI-routed). Safe to leave or clean up.
